data_notes.text: No news feed connected: the model ran on prices, fundamentals and earnings dates only. Connect Sofo World news (db-1 or the S3 export) for the news signal.

No historical options prices: IV is estimated from realised volatility. Option results are indicative; the earnings-straddle strategy is disabled because its edge (realised minus implied move) cannot be measured with an estimated implied move.
Sofo World competitor graph not connected: competitors are SEC industry peers and return-correlation peers. The graph's membership is today's when connected.

Macro and political world (policy uncertainty, geopolitical risk, rates, credit, VIX, dollar, oil) was tested in the holdout ablation: it did not forecast next-session market or stock-relative direction, so it is shown as context and not used by the stock model.
Survivorship bias: the universe is today's SEC-listed companies, so stocks that were delisted (bankruptcies, acquisitions) are missing. Real results would be lower.
Earnings surprise is measured against the same quarter a year earlier (no consensus estimates).
